epics.title: Binary Document Text Extraction
epics.jtbd: When I upload a binary document like a PDF or DOCX, I want its text to be correctly extracted, so that full-text search can match against its actual content.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Increase successful text extraction rate for binary files from 0% to 100%
requirements: R1: Extract text from binary files (PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX) during upload using an appropriate parser like Apache Tika

slices.title: Implement binary file text extraction
slices.jtbd: When implementing binary file processing for this epic, I want to use a parser to extract text, so that the document content can be indexed for full-text search.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a binary file upload such as a PDF or DOCX,
When the backend processes the file for indexing,
Then it uses an appropriate parser (like Apache Tika) to extract the text content rather than casting raw bytes to UTF-8.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce binary file indexing failures from 100% to 0%

epics.sixSigmaMetric: Increase UI pagination rendering accuracy from 0% to 100%
requirements: R1: Include total elements and total pages in the paginated search response payload

slices.title: Add pagination metadata to search response
slices.jtbd: When implementing the search response payload patch for this epic, I want to include total elements and total pages, so that the client UI can correctly render pagination controls.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a paginated search request,
When the backend returns results,
Then the response payload includes total elements and total pages alongside the items array.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase presence of pagination metadata in search responses from 0% to 100%
